description: Land Acquisition - Halminiya, Laggala-Pallegama D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring that certain lands are needed for public purpose and will be acquired. The document provides detailed descriptions of multiple land parcels, including their boundaries, extents, and locations. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) which cover land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related matters.
